name: short-01-not-interested
notes: BATCH-01 script #2. Objection pillar. Hook family: contradiction.

scenes.text: "Not interested" isn't an objection. It's a reflex.
scenes.vo: Not interested isn't an objection. It's a reflex.

scenes.text: It fires in under two seconds.
scenes.vo: It fires in under two seconds.

scenes.text: Before they've processed a single word you said.
scenes.vo: Before they've processed a single word you said.

scenes.text: So don't argue with it. Agree.
scenes.vo: So don't argue with it. Agree.

scenes.label: SAY THIS
scenes.text: "Totally fair — you have no idea who I am yet. You've got four SDRs and no call recording. Is that roughly right?"
scenes.vo: Totally fair. You have no idea who I am yet. You've got four SDRs and no call recording. Is that roughly right?

scenes.text: "Totally fair" removes the thing to push against.
scenes.vo: Totally fair removes the thing to push against.

scenes.text: The specific detail proves you did homework — the only credential on a cold call.
scenes.vo: The specific detail proves you did homework. That's the only credential on a cold call.
And never say, just give me thirty seconds.
